result:
I’d make survival less precarious: no one going without food, shelter, or basic medical care because they can’t afford it.

Not because that would solve everything. People would still grieve, disagree, make mistakes, and hurt one another. But so much of life gets consumed by the fear of losing the essentials. I’d change that—give people room to decide what their lives are for, beyond just getting through them.
